description: Brazil's official market numbers in one call, from Banco Central do Brasil: PTAX exchange rates (closing buy and sell, 1-day and 1-week change, intraday bulletin) for USD, EUR and up to 5 currencies; Selic target with its last change, effective Selic, CDI and the real rate; IPCA and IGP-M inflation (month and 12-month); Focus survey medians for IPCA, Selic, GDP and USD/BRL; and the bank-holiday calendar (business day today, next one, D+2). Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

currency.description: PTAX currencies, comma-separated, up to 5: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, DKK, NOK, SEK (default USD,EUR)
